question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

UCZE, BXGL, ISNS, ?, WIBG
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letter → (7) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (5) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (5) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b20a0eef9bdd99155514644827e77fe0100776b06e1b28bbb470c731fe6e6db.png] ​

​Hence, "**PNUZ**" is the correct answer.
